stories.title: Susan Dell's Trump Accounts video
stories.summary: A clip of Susan Dell, Michael Dell's wife, urging families to register for Trump Accounts (the Dells are putting $250 into each of 25 million kids' accounts) went viral for her look and delivery. "What the FUCK is that" got 38K likes, "the horrors of Susan Dell" (41K) became shorthand, and the jokes and cosplays ran into the next week. Michael Dell answered with "Promise made. Promise kept." (60K), and Eric Trump called the reaction awful.
